dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for joining me today.

dialogue.content: こんばんはどうぞ宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: それでは始めたいと思います。相談内容、年齢、性別を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin. Could you please tell me what you'd like to talk about, your age, and your gender?

dialogue.content: 19歳　男受験の不安です
dialogue.English: I’m 19, male. I’m anxious about my entrance exams.

dialogue.content: 受験のどういった事に不安があるのですか？
dialogue.English: What specific aspects of the exams are making you anxious?

dialogue.content: 夏休みが終わって、模試の成績があまりよくなかったので不安になりました
dialogue.English: After summer break ended, my mock exam results weren't very good, and that made me anxious.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。成績が良くない状態で受験の事を考えると不安になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's understandable to feel anxious when thinking about the exams when your scores aren't what you'd hoped for.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時、どんな事を考えましたか？
dialogue.English: At that time, what kinds of thoughts went through your mind?

dialogue.content: やばいなまた落ちたらどうしよう
dialogue.English: "Oh no, what if I fail again?"

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。次また同じ様な事になったら、ますます怖くなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. The thought of the same thing happening again must be even more frightening.

dialogue.content: 怖いです。悪いことばっかり考えちゃいます
dialogue.English: It is scary. I can't help but think about the worst-case scenarios.

dialogue.content: どんな悪い事を考えましたか？
dialogue.English: What kind of worst-case scenarios have you been thinking about?

dialogue.content: 希望の大学に入れなくて
dialogue.English: That I won’t get into my preferred university,

dialogue.content: いろいろあきらめてる
dialogue.English: and having to give up on a lot of things.

dialogue.content: 「いろいろあきらめている」は、どんな事をあきらめているんですか？
dialogue.English: When you say "giving up on a lot of things," what kind of things are you referring to?

dialogue.content: 楽しい大学生活とか…
dialogue.English: Like, having a fun university life...

dialogue.content: ストレスをどうにかしたいって思います
dialogue.English: I just want to do something about this stress.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。志望校に入れなかったら、大学生活もないですもんね。
dialogue.English: I understand. If you couldn’t get into your first-choice school, it can feel like that vision of university life would disappear, can’t it?

dialogue.content: 不安から来るストレスを解消したいんですね。
dialogue.English: So you want to find a way to relieve the stress that comes from this anxiety.

dialogue.content: はい。今、頑張るときだとはわかっているので、うまく気持ちを上げたい
dialogue.English: Yes. I know this is the time I need to work hard, so I want to find a good way to lift my spirits.

dialogue.content: 気持ちを前向きに、やる気になるようにしたいのですね。すごくいいですね。
dialogue.English: You want to feel more positive and motivated. That's a great goal.

dialogue.content: はい志望校に受かるために頑張りたい親にも迷惑かけてるし
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to work hard to get into my first-choice school, and I also feel like I'm a burden to my parents.

dialogue.content: 親御さんに何か負担をかけさせているのですか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel you’re placing some burden on your parents?

dialogue.content: 浪人してるので、予備校の費用を出してもらってる。悪いなと思ってます
dialogue.English: I'm studying for another year after not passing last year, so they're paying for my prep school tuition. I feel bad about it.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。予備校の費用を出してもらっていると、恩返しをしないとって考えますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. When they're paying for your prep school, it's natural to feel like you have to repay their kindness.

dialogue.content: はい。なんか申し訳ないなって
dialogue.English: Yes. I just feel so guilty.

dialogue.content: それで浪人している状態で、模試の結果が悪く余計に不安になったのですね。
dialogue.English: So, on top of studying for another year, the poor mock exam results made you feel even more anxious.

dialogue.content: では、やる気が出るにはどうすればいいか考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Then let’s think together about what might help you feel more motivated.

dialogue.content: やばい。このままじゃいけない。頑張らなきゃと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought, "This is bad. I can’t go on like this. I need to work harder."

dialogue.content: すごく親御さん思いなんですね。
dialogue.English: You're very considerate of your parents.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 話は戻りますが、現在の志望校、どうしてそこにしたのですか？
dialogue.English: Going back a bit, regarding your current first-choice school, what led you to choose it?

dialogue.content: 学びたい学部があるのと、憧れている学校なので
dialogue.English: It has the department I want to study in, and it's a school I've always admired.

dialogue.content: 学校、学ぶ内容共に惹かれるものがあるのですね。どんな事を学びたいと思っているのですか？
dialogue.English: So you're drawn to both the school itself and what you can learn there. What is it that you want to study?

dialogue.content: 社会学部で広く学んで将来進む道を考えていきたい
dialogue.English: I want to study a wide range of subjects in the Faculty of Social Sciences and figure out my future path.

dialogue.content: 何かそこには相談者さまの将来につながるモノがあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Is there something there that you feel connects to your future?

dialogue.content: まだやりたいことがはっきり決まっていないので、大学の4年間で方向を決めたい
dialogue.English: I haven't decided exactly what I want to do yet, so I'd like to figure out my direction during my four years at university.

dialogue.content: 勉強しながら、いろんな分野を見てみたいのですね。将来はこうなったらいいなとかありますか？
dialogue.English: So you want to explore various fields while you study. Do you have any hopes for what your future might look like?

dialogue.content: 自分の強みを生かして、生き生きと毎日を過ごしていたらいいかな
dialogue.English: I hope I can use my strengths and live each day to the fullest.

dialogue.content: なるほど。自分の得意な面を生かしていけるのは、とてもすばらしいと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I see. Being able to utilize your strengths is truly wonderful.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、現時点で生き生きとして過ごしていける道に進むにはどうすればよいと思いますか？
dialogue.English: So, as of right now, what do you think you need to do to get on the path to living a fulfilling life?

dialogue.content: 受験のストレスに負けないで勉強頑張る…かな
dialogue.English: I guess... not give in to the stress of the exams and study hard.

dialogue.content: ええ、勉強を頑張る、いいと思いますよ。ではあとストレスをどうにかしたいという点について。
dialogue.English: Yes, studying hard is a great idea. Now, about the point you made earlier about wanting to manage your stress.

dialogue.content: はいこうやって話ができると気持ちが楽になります
dialogue.English: Yes, being able to talk like this makes me feel lighter.

dialogue.content: 受験に失敗することを考えてしまいストレスになるという事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is the stress mainly from thinking about failing the exams?

dialogue.content: 気持ちが楽になってよかったです。
dialogue.English: I’m glad you’re feeling a bit lighter.

dialogue.content: 成績とかやらなきゃいけないことが多いとか孤独感
dialogue.English: It's my grades, having so much I have to do, and a sense of loneliness.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。浪人の状態だと、同級生と一緒に勉強する訳じゃないから独りを実感しますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. When you're studying for an extra year, you're not with your former classmates, so that feeling of being alone can be very real.

dialogue.content: 実は9月からクラスが変わって、それまで悩みを話せていた友達と話せなくなってしまいました
dialogue.English: Actually, my class changed in September, and I can't talk to the friend I used to confide in anymore.

dialogue.content: だからいつも1人です
dialogue.English: So now I'm always alone.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。今まで悩みを話せる友達がいたのに、話せなくなるのは辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be tough to suddenly lose the ability to talk with a friend you could open up to.

dialogue.content: はい。それまでなんとも思わなかったけど、そいつと話して元気もらってたことがよく分かりました
dialogue.English: Yes. I didn't think much of it before, but now I realize how much energy I got from talking with him.

dialogue.content: 居なくなって初めて気づいたのですね。さみしいですね。だれかとこのように悩みを話せると、勉強のストレスもどうにかなりそうですか？
dialogue.English: So you only realized it after you were separated. That must feel lonely. If you had someone to talk to about your worries like this, do you think the stress from studying would be more manageable?

dialogue.content: そうですね。話すとまた頑張ろうって気持ちになります。みんな大変なんだとわかるし
dialogue.English: I think so. When I talk to someone, I feel motivated to try again. It also helps me realize that everyone is going through a tough time.

dialogue.content: 今まで話すことでストレスを解消されていたんですね。
dialogue.English: So, talking with others has been your way of relieving stress.

dialogue.content: だれかそういう存在があれば勉強は頑張れそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could study hard if you had someone like that in your life now?

dialogue.content: 新しいクラスはもうグループができていて自分は入れない…
dialogue.English: In my new class, groups have already formed, and I can't seem to fit in...

dialogue.content: その友達に連絡してみようかな
dialogue.English: Maybe I should try reaching out to that friend.

dialogue.content: 前のクラスの時の友人とは、連絡がとれますか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to get in touch with your friend from your previous class?

dialogue.content: はい一応LINEは知ってます
dialogue.English: Yes, I do have their LINE contact, at least.

dialogue.content: それでは、一度メッセージを送ってみてはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In that case, how about you try sending him a message?

dialogue.content: 相手も勉強があるし…迷惑にならないか少し心配です
dialogue.English: He's busy studying too... I'm a little worried I'd be bothering him.

dialogue.content: なるほど。変なタイミングで送ったら、えっ？って思われるかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You're worried that if you message him at a bad time, he might just think, "Huh?" right?

dialogue.content: あまり変な時間帯では無く、その方を心配するような文面で送ってみてはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Perhaps you could send it at a reasonable hour, with a message that expresses your concern for how they’re doing.

dialogue.content: めんどくさいと思われたらやだなみたいに、ちょっと心配しすぎですね
dialogue.English: I'm probably overthinking it, worrying that he might find it annoying.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: そういうLINEが来たら嬉しいかも
dialogue.English: I’d probably be happy to receive a message like that myself.

dialogue.content: そうですね。大抵は心配してもらっていると思うと、うれしいものですよ。
dialogue.English: Exactly. Most people are happy to know someone is thinking about them.

dialogue.content: 確かに。ちょっと勇気がいりますが、やってみようかな
dialogue.English: True. It takes a little courage, but I might give it a try.

dialogue.content: いいと思いますよ。むしろこっちが受験への勇気付けてやろうという意気込みなら、メッセージを送る気がしませんか？
dialogue.English: I think that's a great idea. In fact, what if you approached it with the mindset of encouraging him for his exams? Wouldn't that make it easier to send a message?

dialogue.content: きっとみんな不安かもですね。確かに励まし合う感じがいいかもです
dialogue.English: I guess everyone is probably anxious. You're right, encouraging each other sounds like a good idea.

dialogue.content: そうですね。お互い助け合える・励ましあえる関係というのは、とても良いですね。
dialogue.English: It is. A relationship where you can support and encourage each other is a very wonderful thing.

dialogue.content: そろそろ時間ですが、お時間は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: We're almost out of time. Is that okay with you?

dialogue.content: はい。なんか友達に連する気になったら元気出てきました
dialogue.English: Yes. Somehow, just feeling like contacting my friend has lifted my spirits.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。今回、勉強のストレスをどうにかしたいという相談でした。それに対しご友人に連絡を取ってやり取りをしてみるという事になりました。
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that. Today you consulted about wanting to manage the stress around studying. We decided that you would try reaching out to your friend and exchanging messages.

dialogue.content: 質問も大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any questions?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。たくさん寄り添っていただき話しやすかったです
dialogue.English: No, I'm okay. You were very empathetic, which made it easy to talk.

dialogue.content: 力になれてよかったです。それでは以上で終わりたいと思います。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: I’m glad I could be of help. Let’s wrap up here for today. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイ、どうもありがとうございました。また機会があればよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much for the role-play. I look forward to another opportunity if it arises.)

dialogue.content: 今回がはじめてのロールプレイ参加でした。大変勉強になりました！ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: This was my first time participating in a role-play. It was a great learning experience! Thank you!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ。私もとても勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。それでは失礼します。
dialogue.English: Likewise. I learned a great deal as well. Thank you. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.
